headline: Referred Teamsters Local 251 water utility contract and 43 Broad Street parking lot lease to committees; approved pension appointments.
summary: The council referred a labor contract with Teamsters Local 251 to the Finance Committee. It referred a parking lot lease renewal for 43 Broad Street to the City Property Committee. It also approved a pole petition at George St. and several appointments.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda on a unanimous voice vote.
Approved the records of the August 5, 2026 Committee on Claims and Pending Suits meeting and City Council meeting as prepared by the Clerk.
Took the Elisha Project and Downtown Gateway Development communication off the consent agenda for comments only; no other action was taken.
Referred the collective bargaining agreement between Teamsters Local 251 and the Pawtucket Water Supply Board, for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029, to the Finance Committee.
Referred the parking lot lease renewal for 43 Broad Street to the City Property Committee.
Referred four damage claims against the city to the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits.
Referred damage claims by Joshua Overdeep ($500,000.00) and Dale McGhee ($1,500,000.00) to the Law Department and RI Interlocal Trust.
Approved a petition for a new pole at George St., pending approval from the Director of Public Works.
Approved Ann-Marie McGee for the Pension Board, pending confirmation by Mayor Donald R. Grebien; vote 7-0.
Confirmed the reappointment of Agueda Del Borgo to the Arts Panel Review Committee; vote 7-0.
Approved former BCI Detective Mark Ramos as a retired member of the Pawtucket Police Department on the Pension Board; vote 7-0.
